name: infection-day pressure marks a new cell doomed
input: a healthy cell between two one-day infections
test:
original = [[1, 0, 1]]
assert simulate_pending_death(original, infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2) == (2, 1, [[2, 3, 2]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 1]]

name: doom remains sticky after pressure disappears
input: two-day infection where one neighbor dies earlier
test:
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0]], infectious_days=2, death_threshold=1) == (3, 2, [[3, 3]])
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2) == (2, 0, [[2, 2]])

name: initial infections can all die on recovery
validates pending-death inputs
input: malformed states and invalid positive integers
